name: Casa Cipriani Milano
positioning: Intimate hotel and private members club in a historic building in Milan's Porta Venezia, in front of the Indro Montanelli Gardens
best_for: Travelers who want a central Milan base within walking distance of La Scala and the Duomo
Guests who value a private spa with a flotation pool, sauna and hammam
Guests drawn to a members-club atmosphere

facts.text: Casa Cipriani Milano is an intimate hotel set within a historic building in Porta Venezia.
Casa Cipriani Milano is also a private members club.
Teatro alla Scala and the Duomo are a 15-minute walk from the hotel.
The hotel is a 10-minute walk from the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II and a 20-minute walk from the Brera District.
The Superior Room has walnut boiserie, oak floors and a Venini chandelier.
The Classic Room overlooks the quiet inner courtyard.
The Spa has six treatment cabins for massages, facials and body treatments.
The Spa has a cryo chamber.
The private, studio-inspired Fitness Centre has Technogym equipment, a Pilates reformer and personal trainers.
The Restaurant's menu includes the Carpaccio and the Bellini, both invented by founder Giuseppe Cipriani.
The Living Room is on the top floor of the building, in a private and intimate setting.
The Concierge Book offers members and hotel guests bespoke experiences around food, art, fashion and places.

highlights.text: The Club sits in historic Milanese settings in front of the Indro Montanelli Gardens.
The Signature Suite is open-plan, with high ceilings and tall windows overlooking the Indro Montanelli Gardens.
Members and hotel guests have exclusive access to the wellness facilities, including a flotation pool, Finnish sauna and hammam.
The Premier Corner Room has panoramic views of Corso Venezia and the Indro Montanelli Gardens.
Casa Cipriani Sailing offers sailing lessons for beginners and experienced sailors on Lake Maggiore, one hour from Milan.

considerations.text: Children are welcome at the restaurants until 6pm; after 6pm under-18s are not permitted in any areas of the Club.
The Club has a dress code, and gentlemen must wear long sleeves after 6pm.
Photography and videography are forbidden on Club premises.
